description: Set how many extra portions one planned dinner cooks for the next day's lunchboxes, 0 to 10; without portions it follows the household's weekday setting again. Lunch is not planned: the extra portions are bought and cooked with the dinner. A dish that should not be heated again makes none.

portions.description: Extra portions for the next day's lunchboxes, 0–10. Leave it out to follow the household's weekday setting again.

name: set_lunchbox_portions
title: Set lunchboxes from a dinner
